fortunes.text: The day will be ordinary, and ordinary is a gift.
fortunes.recommended_action: Commit your work and enjoy the quiet.

fortunes.text: A small test will fail, then pass, then teach you something.
fortunes.recommended_action: Read the assertion before you rerun it.

fortunes.text: Your next commit will be dull in the best way.
fortunes.recommended_action: Write a message your colleague can trust.

fortunes.text: The build will stay green if you keep the change narrow.
fortunes.recommended_action: Leave the ambitious rewrite for a named ticket.

fortunes.text: A reviewer will say this looks fine, and they will be right.
fortunes.recommended_action: Merge it and go outside for a minute.

fortunes.text: The logs will be quiet enough to hear yourself think.
fortunes.recommended_action: Use the calm to write down one real risk.

fortunes.text: No incident will need you for the next few hours.
fortunes.recommended_action: Take the break you already earned.

fortunes.text: A rename will make a function kinder.
fortunes.recommended_action: Ship the rename and nothing else.

fortunes.text: The ticket is smaller than your worry about it.
fortunes.recommended_action: Do the first honest step and stop there.

fortunes.text: Documentation you write now will save a Tuesday.
fortunes.recommended_action: Add the paragraph while the context is fresh.

fortunes.text: A warning in the build is trying to become a bug.
fortunes.recommended_action: Read the failing test before rerunning it.

fortunes.text: Two config files have started to disagree.
fortunes.recommended_action: Diff them before you deploy either.

fortunes.text: The flaky check will pass if you look at the timing.
fortunes.recommended_action: Note the flake instead of clicking again.

fortunes.text: A dependency wants a bump you did not schedule.
fortunes.recommended_action: Read the changelog before you accept it.

fortunes.text: The migration is one column more interesting than planned.
fortunes.recommended_action: Update the rollback note before you continue.

fortunes.text: A monitor is yellow for a reason the dashboard hides.
fortunes.recommended_action: Open the raw log before you silence the alert.

fortunes.text: The branch is old enough to have opinions.
fortunes.recommended_action: Rebase it or close it before it spreads.

fortunes.text: An environment variable is set in one place and hoped in another.
fortunes.recommended_action: Write down where the real value lives.

fortunes.text: The queue is growing at a polite but steady rate.
fortunes.recommended_action: Check the consumer before you add a producer.

fortunes.text: A permission change will surprise a job that runs at night.
fortunes.recommended_action: List the callers before you tighten the rule.

fortunes.text: The pipeline is green, but the omens remain ambiguous.
fortunes.recommended_action: Inspect the rollback plan before celebrating.

fortunes.text: A deploy you consider small has a wide blast radius.
fortunes.recommended_action: Review the rollback plan.

fortunes.text: The canary is quiet because it is not receiving traffic.
fortunes.recommended_action: Confirm the route before you promote.

fortunes.text: An expired secret is closer than the calendar admits.
fortunes.recommended_action: Rotate it while the old one still works.

fortunes.text: The database migration wants a lock you have not timed.
fortunes.recommended_action: Rehearse the lock on a copy first.

fortunes.text: Two regions will disagree if you ship only one.
fortunes.recommended_action: Finish the pair or ship neither.

fortunes.text: The feature flag default is not the default you think.
fortunes.recommended_action: Read the production value before the demo.

fortunes.text: A retry storm is one bad error away.
fortunes.recommended_action: Cap the retries before you raise the timeout.

fortunes.text: The backup you trust has not been restored this year.
fortunes.recommended_action: Restore a scrap of it before you need all of it.

fortunes.text: The on-call gap is exactly as wide as this change.
fortunes.recommended_action: Wait for a human who can roll it back.

fortunes.text: The Friday deploy button has started making eye contact.
fortunes.recommended_action: Step away from the Friday deployment button.

fortunes.text: A force push is being considered as a personality trait.
fortunes.recommended_action: Close the laptop and talk to a person.

fortunes.text: The production console is open, and curiosity is in the room.
fortunes.recommended_action: Log out before curiosity types anything.

fortunes.text: All the alarms are muted, which is not the same as peace.
fortunes.recommended_action: Unmute one true alarm before you leave.

fortunes.text: The migration script has no limit and a great deal of confidence.
fortunes.recommended_action: Add a limit and run it somewhere harmless.

fortunes.text: Someone is about to debug production with a write query.
fortunes.recommended_action: Use a read-only session and a second pair of eyes.

fortunes.text: The cluster is one full disk away from a folk tale.
fortunes.recommended_action: Free space before you ship anything else.

fortunes.text: A config paste from chat is heading toward the real environment.
fortunes.recommended_action: Stop and type it from the source of truth.

fortunes.text: The rollback button is decorative.
fortunes.recommended_action: Do not deploy until the way back is real.

fortunes.text: The change is brave, late, and unreviewed.
fortunes.recommended_action: Save the branch and go home.
